issue_context.title: Refactor schedulerOptions to prevent global setters in parallelism
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
Refactor schedulerOptions to prevent global setters in parallelism

**Why is this needed**:
#94636 adds a global setter for Parallelism. The current implementation does not prevent modification of parallelism after scheduler initialisation. For a long term solution, we need to move this to framework and drop the package var, so that this should only be called once per scheduler process and should be called before starting any goroutines that use the parallel functionality.
